text: Hi, I'm Siddhant. Quick question for everyone living on mess food.
Dal, rice and roti only cover part of it. The rest is a gap.
You answer five quick questions, including the ones other apps skip: do you have a kettle, and how many mess meals do you eat?
Then pick a daily pack, like a mobile recharge. Each one is mathematically the cheapest mix.
Now drag the budget, and watch the whole plate rebuild as you go.
That's the lowest price that actually hits the target.
Don't like something? Skip it, and it re-plans instantly. You can even type in what your local shop charges.
And it turns the plan into a weekly shopping list.
To put it online, I copied one prompt from Embarko's website.
Pasted it into Claude Code. It packed the app, uploaded it, and kept checking the status. This is the real deploy, sped up.
No Dockerfile. No repo. One sign-in, and it's mine to keep.
Try it free at protein recharge dot embarko dot app. Hashtag Deploy With Embarko.
